channel.title: Krishna Thota
channel.description: Hi there! I'm Krishna. I'm a software engineer based in the Bay Area, California.\n\nI created this space to share the things I'm most passionate about: the evolving world of AI, the precision of a perfect bowl of ramen, and the chaos and beauty of traveling the globe with the people I love.

item.title: Hello World 🌍
item.description: Welcome to my new blog! 🚀 I'll be sharing my journey exploring AI, technology, and building cool things.
